The '''''Daunted Gypsy''''' was a [[Jermaguim-class Light Freighter|''Jermaguim''-class Light Freighter]] operated by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. It was used by Republic operatives during the [[Freedom Strike Seltos]] operation.
